title: Acceptance Terms: Which Vehicles the Keyturn Host Protection Plan Writes Cover On
content:
A vehicle is accepted onto a plan of the Keyturn Host Protection Plan only where it sits inside that plan's age, odometer, value, title and territory limits, and a vehicle failing any one of them is refused rather than moved to a plan that would take it.

### Age and value

Vehicle age is counted in whole years from the model year to the year the application is made, so a vehicle of the model year exactly at the plan's limit is still accepted. The declared value must sit between the plan's floor and its ceiling, and where the marketplace's own valuation of the vehicle differs from the host's declaration by more than 10 percent, the marketplace's valuation governs and the host is told the plan the vehicle actually qualifies for.

### Inspection

Cover on plans that require it begins only where a passed inspection already stands on the vehicle record, and a report of an inspection the host says was carried out is not a substitute for the inspection record itself. The inspection standing on the vehicle is read before cover is made live, and it is matched to the vehicle the enrolment is being written on.

### Title

A vehicle whose title status is not among the plan's eligible title statuses is refused, and a financed or leased vehicle is accepted only where the lienholder consent document has been verified on the listing. The title status is read from the vehicle's own listing record for the vehicle being enrolled, and the statuses the marketplace recognises are a clean title, a title held by a lienholder under finance, and a leased title.

### When cover starts

Where the application is accepted, cover starts on the day the protection team records activation and never earlier, so a loss on a trip that ran before activation is not covered however soon afterwards the enrolment went live.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A vehicle whose model year is exactly the plan's age limit: accepted, because age is counted in whole years to the year of application.
- A host declares 20000 and the marketplace values the vehicle at 21500, a difference of 7.5 percent: the declaration stands.
- A host declares 20000 and the marketplace values the vehicle at 24000, a difference of 20 percent: the marketplace's valuation governs and the host is told which plan the vehicle qualifies for.
